name: When should I call a professional contractor for window water damage?

mainEntity.name: When should I call a professional contractor for window water damage?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should call a professional contractor if you notice persistent leaks, extensive staining, soft or crumbling wood, or any signs of mold growth. If the damage extends beyond the immediate window frame into the wall cavity, or if you're unsure about the source of the leak, a professional assessment is crucial. Contractors can accurately diagnose the problem, identify hidden damage, address structural issues, and ensure proper repairs are made to prevent recurrence. Attempting complex repairs without expertise can lead to further damage or inadequate solutions.
acceptedAnswer.description: Call a professional for persistent leaks, extensive damage, mold, structural concerns, or if you can't identify the source of the leak.
